summary.en: Read words or whole lines with bounded input, handle newlines, and print text without format-string mistakes.
summary.bn: সীমা মেনে শব্দ বা পুরো লাইন পড়ো, শেষে থাকা নিউলাইন সরাও আর নিরাপদে টেক্সট প্রিন্ট করো।

notes: fgets is standard from C89 onward. C11 removed gets; C17 and C23 do not restore it. The shown programs target C17 and keep fixed capacities so their line policies are visible.

examples.title: Read a bounded word
examples.explanationHtml: The conversion stores CSE212 and its zero terminator. Width seven is one less than the eight-element buffer.

examples.title: Preserve spaces in a line
examples.explanationHtml: fgets keeps both words. strcspn finds the first newline, which is replaced by a zero.

examples.title: Compare puts and printf
examples.explanationHtml: puts appends a newline. The percent sign in the data is harmless because printf receives a fixed format.

examples.title: Reject and drain a long line
examples.explanationHtml: The seventh stored character proves the six-character limit was exceeded. The remaining input is discarded through newline or EOF.

practice.title: Read a room name
practice.statementHtml: Read one ASCII line of 0 to 80 characters, followed by newline. Print Line: then the line in square brackets without its input newline.
hints: Replace a found newline before adding your own output newline.

practice.title: Read two course tokens
practice.statementHtml: Read two whitespace-separated ASCII tokens of 1 to 15 characters each. Print Course and section: then the tokens separated by a hyphen.
hints: Both buffers need an independent width.

practice.title: Remove only the line ending
practice.statementHtml: Read an ASCII line of at most 80 characters with a newline. Print Line: then the number of bytes after removing the newline; preserve trailing spaces.
hints: Spaces before newline belong to the text.

practice.title: Recover after an oversized token
practice.statementHtml: Read a nonempty ASCII line terminated by newline. Print Short line: and accept at most four characters, printing the line; otherwise print REJECT. Drain an oversized line.
hints: Reserve enough space to detect a fifth character.

quiz.prompt: What is the largest safe %s width for char code[8]?
quiz.explanation: scanf adds a null character after the converted characters.

quiz.prompt: What normally stops scanf %s after skipping leading whitespace?
quiz.explanation: %s reads a whitespace-delimited token rather than a whole line.

quiz.prompt: Which input function accepts spaces with a destination-size argument?
quiz.explanation: fgets takes the buffer capacity and can keep spaces.

quiz.prompt: When fgets reads a newline before filling its buffer, where does it go?
options: Into the buffer before the terminator
quiz.explanation: The caller may remove that newline after checking the returned pointer.

quiz.prompt: Which call prints arbitrary input text safely as data?
quiz.explanation: A constant format prevents percent signs in the input from becoming conversions.
The caller cannot tell gets where writable storage ends.

quiz.prompt: What should a failed first fgets call prevent?
options: Any later use of puts in the program
quiz.explanation: Check for NULL before examining bytes that were not successfully read.

quiz.prompt: How does puts differ from printf when printing the percent text?
quiz.explanation: puts adds the first newline, and printf supplies its own brackets and newline.

quiz.prompt: What length is stored when a newline is replaced in a short line?
quiz.explanation: Removing the newline leaves three visible characters.

quiz.prompt: Which unread newline remains after scanf reads one token?
quiz.explanation: Both letters are kept when spaces are present in a character array.

keyPoints.en: A scanf string width leaves room for a final null character.
keyPoints.bn: scanf-এর স্ট্রিংয়ের প্রস্থ ঠিক করলে শেষে null ক্যারেক্টারের জায়গাও রাখো।

keyPoints.en: fgets reads spaces and may retain the newline.
keyPoints.bn: fgets স্পেস পড়ে আর নিউলাইনও রেখে দিতে পারে।

keyPoints.en: A full input buffer may hold only part of a line.
keyPoints.bn: ইনপুট বাফার ভরে গেলে লাইনের কিছু অংশ বাকি থাকতে পারে।

keyPoints.en: puts adds a newline while printf follows its format.
keyPoints.bn: puts শেষে নিউলাইন যোগ করে, আর printf ফরম্যাট মেনে চলে।

keyPoints.en: The unsafe gets function was removed in C11.
keyPoints.bn: অনিরাপদ gets ফাংশন C11 থেকে বাদ দেওয়া হয়েছে।

examQuestions.question: Explain why mixing scanf("%d", &n) followed by fgets often reads an empty-looking line.
examQuestions.answerHtml: The integer conversion leaves its trailing newline unread. fgets then consumes that newline. Prefer one line-based input strategy, or deliberately consume the rest of the numeric line before reading the next line; do not add a trailing space to the scanf format.

A B

Both letters are kept when spaces are present in a character array.

examQuestions.question: Read a nonempty ASCII line terminated by newline. Print Short line: and accept at most four characters, printing the line; otherwise print REJECT. Drain an oversized line.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

int main(void)
{
    char text[6];
    puts("Short line:");
    if (fgets(text, sizeof text, stdin) == NULL) {
        return 1;
    }
    if (strchr(text, '\n') == NULL && strlen(text) > 4) {
        int ch;
        while ((ch = getchar()) != '\n' && ch != EOF) {
        }
        puts("REJECT");
    } else {
        text[strcspn(text, "\n")] = '\0';
        puts(text);
    }
    return 0;
}

Reserve enough space to detect a fifth character.
